newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed - gas oil up on tight supply.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed - gas oil up on tight supply.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Tuesday, traders said.
Gas oil prices were firmer with tightening ARA supplies boosting barge and steadying cargo premiums.
Brokers said prompt barge supplies were becoming fairly tight and although end-user demand was balanced, trade house short-covering had boosted premiums by around 50 cents.
Prompt barges were bid at July IPE +$1 with offers at +$1.50 a tonne fob Rotterdam with Flushing barges offered at July IPE +75 cents/+$1 fob. Diesel barges trade at July IPE +$5 fob ARA.
